## Evidence boundary

- The corpus and questions are original neutral technical fiction; no private corpus is transformed or copied.
- Vectors are fixed synthetic fixture vectors; network, credentials, real Embedding and LLM calls are all absent.
- Exact-cosine candidates and these metrics validate deterministic evaluation and reranker behavior only. They do not establish real retrieval quality, RAG answer quality or production acceptance.
- Unanswerable false positives mean the retriever returned any Top K chunk; this fixture does not add a calibrated abstention threshold.
- No quality release threshold is inferred from this small synthetic set.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```powershell
& 'backend\evals\scripts\run_public_small_retrieval_ab.ps1'
```
